name: Knockout bracket matches the editorial design (flag chips, rank badges, green winner, champion panel)
description: The landing knockout bracket reproduces the provided design: per-tie white cards with two teams, a flag chip + 3-letter country code, a FIFA-rank badge, the predicted winner highlighted (green) with a chevron, connector lines between rounds, and a PREDICTED CHAMPION panel.

planSteps.description: Navigate to / and inspect the knockout bracket region

Verify the bracket shows the rounds (Round of 16 → Quarter-finals → Semi-finals → Final) as cards, each tie listing two teams with a flag chip + 3-letter code and a rank badge (e.g. #6), the predicted winner of each tie visually highlighted (green/accent, distinct from the loser), and a PREDICTED CHAMPION panel with a flag + nation. A plain text list or a bracket missing flags/rank-badges/winner-highlight/champion-panel fails.
